answer: The ivory schedule is applied in dune and signal makes public each instalment. A payout is split and thus 20% arrives at settlement and the rest over 13 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Anyone hence cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 938 identities would post 3290 proofs and burn roughly 45 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
